Step 14 contract (Dev builds, Design's tracker reads): bh task show <id> --json gives each step an 'events' array, oldest first, each { at, kind, text, detail, from }. kind 'board': a board post with step === n (text = the post, detail = the board kind). kind 'report': step.report (text = summary, detail = file). kind 'check': a checks.jsonl receipt with step === n (text = 'Checks passed' or 'Checks failed', detail = '<tests> tests' plus ', full suite' when fallback). kind 'merge': a task.children entry for the step with state merged (text = 'Merged <name>', detail = '+<added> −<removed>', at = mergedAt). Each step also gets 'agentName' (step.agent or the open child's name) and 'elapsedMs' (workedMs plus the running time when active). The task gets 'done' and 'total' step counts. Live 'what it is doing now' is not in the JSON: the chat maps a step's agent to its live terminal and reads doing[address] as the rail does.
